{{recipe}}

'''Dereniówka''', is a type of Polish ''nalewka'' made from ''cornus'' ''mas'' (dogwood). It, among other ''nalewkas'', were popular in noble manors of 17th CE Poland. Dereniówka belongs to the family of fruit ''nalewkas'', such as ''orzechówka'', ''wiśniówka'', and ''porzeczkówka''. These ''nalewkas'' usually contain sugar and/or honey and need to be macerated and aged longer than other kinds.

== Ingredients ==

* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] dried ''cornus alba'' fruits or pre-prepared ''Herbatka Podlaska dereniówka''
* [[Cookbook:Vodka|Vodka]] (~45% alcohol)
* 40 g white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Macerating|Macerate]] the ''cornus alba'' fruits in vodka for 14 days. Shake the concoction daily.
# When the alcoholate is ready, remove the sediments and add the sugar.
# Let it clarify and rest for a while (several days only), and then it is ready for consumption.
# Serve at room temperature in 30 ml glasses.

== References ==
*'''(Polish)''' (2004) Jan Rogala, ''Gorzałka czyli...'', Baobab, Warszawa {{#isbn:83-89642-70-0}}
*http://www.darynatury.pl/darysklep/sklep.php?m=3
